summary: Lower JavaScript exponentiation through a helper because Number and BigInt exponentiation have distinct edge semantics.

target.notes: Apply ToNumeric in order. Mixed Number/BigInt throws TypeError. BigInt negative exponents throw RangeError. Number exponentiation follows ECMAScript Number::exponentiate, whose corner cases are not safely assumed identical to Math.Pow.

caveats: Do not map blindly to Math.Pow.
BigInt exponentiation may require explicit resource limits in hostile inputs while preserving observable exceptions where possible.
